investment_strategy: Barbell quality-and-growth approach focused on the A.I. stack. Anchor the portfolio in resilient, cash-generative cloud/platform leaders (Microsoft, Alphabet) with strong fundamentals and positive analyst support, complemented by a smaller, risk-managed allocation to the leading A.I. compute supplier (NVIDIA) for upside participation. Given VIX near 20 and a 10Y yield ~4.2%, size risk conservatively, emphasize profitability and EPS beat consistency, and monitor policy/regulatory and supply-chain risks. Stagger entries or add on market pullbacks, rebalance quarterly, and trim on outsized moves.
